name: What is the process for professional mold removal in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional mold removal in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional mold removal typically begins with an inspection to assess the extent of the mold. The area is then contained to prevent spores from spreading to other parts of your home. Technicians use specialized equipment, such as HEPA vacuums and air scrubbers, to remove mold spores from the air. Affected materials are carefully removed and disposed of. Surfaces are cleaned and treated with antimicrobial solutions. Finally, the area is dried thoroughly, and post-remediation testing may be conducted to confirm mold levels are normal.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, containment, removal of mold and affected materials, cleaning, treatment, and thorough drying to prevent recurrence.
